item.title: How to debug Vue lifecycle hooks
item.description: Debugging Vue lifecycle hooks helps understand component behavior, timing issues, and execution order during initialization and updates. As the creator of CoreUI, I’ve debugged countless lifecycle issues in complex applications. Vue lifecycle hooks execute at specific moments in component lifecycle providing insight into mounting, updating, and unmounting phases. This approach reveals timing issues, state problems, and helps optimize component performance.
